title: Chapter 319 Discussion, Up Or Not Up!
content:
Chapter 319 Discussion, Up Or Not Up!

Now that Kazuko's husband has died, the pillars of the family have completely collapsed, leaving her, a son and a daughter alone in this troubled world, and the orphans and widows alone cannot survive.

Therefore, it is necessary to find a strong man to attach to, and the man in front of him easily killed that powerful demon, that is an existence that even his husband can kill.

With this kind of strength, it's no wonder that Kazumi was so anxious, not even a day after her husband died.

So she dressed herself up in a full-bodied attire, and showed her most beautiful side in front of Zhong Yu.

He just prayed that she would take a fancy to him, and then bless him and his sons and daughters.

Otherwise, in this troubled world, people's hearts are sinister, if Zhong Yu doesn't care about their mother and child. I'm afraid that their family will be bullied wantonly by the villagers in the village.

After being abused, it was sold far away, and since then it has begun a journey of exile in troubled times.

How can this kind of thing that is very likely to happen in the future not frighten this weak woman.

For these humble villagers, it is definitely an insurmountable spiritual enjoyment to enjoy the superior samurai, or the wife and daughter of the samurai who oppressed them.

Nowadays, the islanders are evil and perverted, bullying the weak and afraid of the strong, cruel and bloodthirsty, they will definitely do it.

They don't talk about the idea that the master and children should not be bullied, but should be well protected.

They will only use the cruelest means to deal with orphans and widows who have lost their protection, to satisfy their dirty and dirty psychology.

And the only way to prevent them from suffering that tragic fate is for Zhong Yu in front of him to accept them and give them a little shelter, which is enough to make those villagers dare not act rashly.

Looking at Kazuko on the ground, she knelt down deeply, the loose kimono on her body couldn't cover her body, and her chest was directly exposed.

Showing her proud capital completely in front of him without any concealment, Zhong Yu's eyes did not fluctuate much, appearing extremely calm.

It's no wonder that Zhong Yu, as the emperor of the empire, after he had decided to let go of his abstinence and accept the heart of women, besides marrying Princess Honglian as the emperor's concubine in Qin Shishijie, he also married more than ten women in succession. A very outstanding woman is the concubine.

Among them, in order to win over Taoist Tianzong, by the way, he got a powerful master for himself. Therefore, Xiaomeng, a peerless genius who is rarely seen in a thousand years in the Tianzong of Taoism who married Taoism.

At the same time, in order to quickly wipe out Qin Shihuang's power to destroy Qin and accelerate the unification of the world, Shi Lan, the direct descendant of Shu Mountain, who had a deep influence in Shu through marriage.

There is also Princess Gao Yue, who made a marriage with the younger brother of Yan Guo and formed a baby relationship.

Also, in order to win over the powerful sect of the Yinyang family, the head of the Yinyang family, the head of the wood, was married.

So Zhong Yu suddenly discovered that there were five concubines before he knew it.

So Zhong Yu doesn't say there are three thousand beauties in the harem, but there are still a few of them. And there are thousands or tens of thousands of palace maids serving beside her.

Don't talk about those concubines, just talk about those maids who serve in the court, the color is much better than this Kazuko, how could he be so crudely seduced by him, and arouse the desire in his heart.

As early as the concubines in the harem were fighting for favor, and you came and went, and various means emerged endlessly, Zhong Yu already had a very strong immunity to all kinds of temptations.

Unless it is the kind of beauty that is so beautiful that everything is hard to find, it is difficult for him to be moved by other women.

But Kazumiko, who is just fair in appearance and just up to standard in figure, is naturally not among them.

Sitting down and kneeling deeply, with a respectful expression, Kazumi looked at Zhong Yu from the corner of her eye.

My heart sank involuntarily.

"What should I do? This powerful adult seems to despise me. Is our family really going to suffer that tragic fate?"

A look of sadness appeared in Kazumi's eyes, and her body, which was tense to show her beautiful figure, also trembled slightly.

Just when Kazuko was thinking wildly and becoming more and more frightened, a voice came from beside her ear.

"Get up, I understand what you're thinking, there's no need to do these things. I'm going to be here for a period of time to recover from my injuries, and I just need someone to take care of them. Looking at the whole village, only you can barely do it."

Zhong Yu said softly, although he rejected Hemiko's inner thoughts, it disappointed Hemiko who wanted to make the relationship between the two parties go further, so that Zhongyu could protect herself more.

"But after all, the powerful adult in front of me still agreed to protect himself, and the fate of our family can be regarded as a little bit guaranteed."

Kazumi said this to herself in her heart, and she had a little brighter future, and her heart that should be grieving for her husband's death also recovered a little.

"It's the liberty to interrupt and disturb the rest of the adults. He deserves death. He Meizi will leave now." He Meizi got up slowly, bowed to Zhong Yu and said, and then carefully exited the room.

Zhong Yu looked at the sound of Kazuko exiting quietly, and couldn't help but have a deeper understanding of the cruel perversion of the islanders.

In fact, the reason why he rejected Kazuko this time was not really because she was not so beautiful, it was just that his body couldn't bear such a heavy burden.

That's right, just can't bear the burden of doing it once.

His body was too fragile, and he had just experienced the movement of true qi, and he had only slightly recovered from the injury on his right index finger. The other parts of the body are equally dilapidated, and the slightest touch will cause a convulsion.

Under such circumstances, how could he have any intention of playing strenuous exercise with the woman in front of him. Aren't you afraid that because you overdraw your body's potential more and more, you will suddenly die, and you will die if you run out of ammunition and food!

But now that his health is not good, when Shao Wei's injury recovers, at least he can recover from his kidney injury. With the capital to fight, it's not impossible to be lucky.

Inexplicably encountered the torrent of chaos, almost killed himself, and then exiled to the inexplicable void, completely lost direction, after several twists and turns, how can Zhong Yu not feel depressed and irritable.

For a man, the best way to solve these negative emotions is to find a woman to mediate.

If it's just for venting, then as long as the woman's appearance is not too sorry for the audience, few men should care about it.

What's more, Kazuko is pretty good-looking, with fair skin and beautiful appearance, elegant figure, and graceful body, she can indeed be called a beauty.

For a beauty of Lin Xing's level, even though Zhong Yu is already immune, she won't feel her heart beating faster or feeling amazed. But at least it doesn't make him sick.

Linxing and Meizi are much better than Linxing and a Fengjie.

Well, according to Zhong Yu's observation, the women who come and go in this small village are basically at the level of Sister Feng.

The few who are decent-looking are just ordinary people, far from beauties.

Therefore, the quality of Kazumi's appearance, in this island country, can still be regarded as the best.

I don't know how the little leader of this village married a wife of this level, it's really surprising.

Zhong Yu thought secretly.

How about it, is there anyone who is hard on this one? Someone definitely thought the main character would be there, right? It's a pity that the author, in his dream yesterday, imitated the sage Huangdi Ye Yuyu 5000 beauties, and ran out of ammunition and food. When I write this today, I can't even bring up the slightest interest. So at this critical moment, the protagonist withered.
